leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute-force solution for rotating array elements by a given number of positions
Apply the array reversal technique to optimize the rotation algorithm
Construct a function that handles edge cases including empty arrays and rotation counts exceeding array length
Manipulate array indices correctly to shift elements without losing data
Initialize and update variables to track positions during the rotation process
Integrate modular arithmetic to handle rotation counts efficiently
Control the algorithm's time and space complexity by selecting appropriate data structures
